_source: Capture and v4 path aliases resolve in config/bench-ninemotor-a6ec.md. Derived from superseded v4 deployed state and sources. This configuration has not moved any axis and does not authorize motion. Follow docs/BENCH_TESTING.md; operator must decide tracking mode before first bus ownership. J7..J9 require homing and measured motion limits.

axes.coordinate_evidence_mode_note: Owner direction 2026-09-14: drive-side gearing, software ratio 1, travel below one output revolution. Startup bracket verification then PDO tracking; mailbox cadence is a consistency check. Measurement sources: docs/evidence/bench-ninemotor-2026-09-13/fixedpdo-e24dea59.log and readback.txt; the log used the old multi_turn configuration digests and is not single-turn startup proof. Review-reported RevPi bench at 8e76f404, bench-relay digest 5b4510f497957865a769c8893f8d399cb33a189f06cb278b0c82498e9aa9e380: J1..J6 verified on attempt 1, all nine axes valid, no faults through a mailbox stall. Anchors persisted under the old digest are refused with ErrIdentity; one Home is required after this upgrade before saving anchors under the new digest.

limits.completion_tolerance_unverified: unverified: config/a6ec-bench.example.json#axes[0].limits.completion_tolerance; rad; measure stationary endpoint error and encoder noise on this axis
limits.following_error_timeout_ms_unverified: unverified: config/a6ec-bench.example.json#axes[0].limits.following_error_timeout_ms; ms; measure tracking-error persistence and fault response on this axis
limits.following_error_unverified: unverified: config/a6ec-bench.example.json#axes[0].limits.following_error; rad; measure maximum tracking error under load on this axis
limits.jog_acceleration_unverified: unverified: config/a6ec-bench.example.json#axes[0].limits.jog_acceleration; profiles/a6ec.json#max_acceleration; rad/s^2; measure ramp and stopping under load. v4 uses 120 rpm/s = 4*pi rad/s^2, which is not qualified for rt-core's profile bound
limits.max_source: derived: v4-status.json#safe_low_raw_counts[0],safe_high_raw_counts[0],hm35_home_position_counts[0],pair_config_upper_limit_rad[0]; v4/realtime-core/src/robot_v4_rtcore.cpp:2784-2810; max-safe-band intersection: min(max((W/180-W/2)/(sign*W/(2*pi)),(W-1-W/180-W/2)/(sign*W/(2*pi))),pair upper); raw telemetry is rounded to counts
limits.max_target_lead_unverified: unverified: measure jog target-to-feedback error at max_velocity and jog_acceleration under load on this axis before use; rt-core faults the axis (FaultTargetLead, rehome_required) when the jog target leads feedback by more than this, whereas v4 used the same figure as a clamp on 20 cycles of requested lead, so the v4 constant is provenance, not a measured tracking bound. Provenance: v4/realtime-core/src/robot_v4_rtcore.cpp:67; v4-status.json#axis_active_jog_max_lead_counts[0]; v4/realtime-core/src/robot_v4_rtcore.cpp:2941-2948,2995-2997; 0.35 degrees * pi/180 rad; active lead clamps 20 cycles of step counts to this angular cap; not a measured stopping envelope
limits.max_velocity_source: owner decision 2026-09-21: the 3000 rpm drive cap (drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm) through this joint's gear ratio, 314.159265 / ratio rad/s (18000 / ratio deg/s), equal to the URDF velocity rating (P8-44); supersedes the v4 0.2 rad/s profile velocity
limits.min_source: derived: v4-status.json#safe_low_raw_counts[0],safe_high_raw_counts[0],hm35_home_position_counts[0],pair_config_lower_limit_rad[0]; v4/realtime-core/src/robot_v4_rtcore.cpp:2784-2810; min(max-safe-band intersection): max(min((W/180-W/2)/(sign*W/(2*pi)),(W-1-W/180-W/2)/(sign*W/(2*pi))),pair lower); raw telemetry is rounded to counts

bus_bringup.explicit_pdo_config_unverified: bench-servo 2026-09-13, docs/evidence/bench-ninemotor-2026-09-13/readback.txt and kernel step logs; nine AS715N A6-EC drives, CoE 22033/22034, SII 0x2ef8. Mapping objects are read-only (0x06010002); use fixed mapping and verify assignment/entries off-cycle before configuration readiness.
bus_bringup.no_dc_unverified: unverified machine semantics: measure distributed-clock startup and synchronization on the bench; false keeps DC enabled.
bus_bringup.preop_safeop_timeout_ms_unverified: unverified machine semantics: measure PREOP to SAFEOP on the bench (ms, 0..4294967295); 0 leaves the master default.
bus_bringup.safeop_op_timeout_ms_unverified: unverified machine semantics: measure SAFEOP to OP on the bench (ms, 0..4294967295); 0 leaves the master default.
bus_bringup.startup_passive_ms_unverified: unverified machine semantics: measure passive startup needed by A6-EC firmware on the bench (ms, 0..4294967295); 0 disables it. Defaults and notes are omitted from legacy artifact identity and argv.
bus_bringup.wait_before_safeop_ms_unverified: unverified machine semantics: measure firmware convergence before SAFEOP on the bench (ms, 0..2147483647); 0 leaves the master default.

max_cycle_lateness_ns_unverified: unverified: config/a6ec-bench.example.json#max_cycle_lateness_ns; measure worst admitted cycle lateness on the RevPi under intended load; captured jitter is not deadline qualification
drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm_source: Owner decision 2026-09-15: A6M rated speed 3000 rpm, spec sheet and A6M60-400H2B1-M17 / A6M80-1000H2B1-M17 part numbers. One motor revolution is 131072 counts in the drive frame regardless of the electronic gear ratio, so a motor speed cap does not scale with the gear: 0x607F counts/s = drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm / 60 * motor_encoder_counts_per_rev. Independent of the inhibited start-up verification speed bound and software limits.max_velocity.
